name: Korean Chili Wings
description: A staff favorite! This amazing sauce starts sweet and ends with heat. Tangy Pluck’d BBQ Sauce, Gochujang (fermented chilis) and a hint of lime zest make this mouthwatering sauce perfectly balanced.

name: Loaded Fries
description: Crispy french fries topped them with our five-cheese sauce, crispy bacon pieces and chives.

name: Rib Tips

description: Grilled Chicken, Crispy Bacon Pieces, Bleu Cheese Crumbles, Diced Cucumber, Fresh Tomatoes, Avocado, Hard Boiled Egg, Ranch Dressing

description: Lettuce blend, red onions, tomatoes, cucumber. Gluten-free.

name: Pulled Pork Sliders
description: Pulled pork tossed in Smokeheads Carolina BBQ Sauce, topped with our house slaw. Served on a soft brioche Bun.

name: Smoked Chicken Wings
description: One dozen of our smoked wings served dry or tossed in your choice of Smokeheads Sauces and finished on the grill. Smokeheads Sauces include Texas Mop BBQ Sauce, Carolina Style BBQ Sauce or Classic Memphis-Style BBQ Sauce. Served with celery sticks and sliced pickles. Gluten-free.

name: Pulled Pork Loaded Fries
description: Crispy seasoned french fries, piled high with our smoked pulled pork, Smokeheads Texas Mop BBQ Sauce, 5-cheese sauce, and crispy bacon.

name: Strawberry Salad
description: Fresh Local Greens, Candied Walnuts, Goat Cheese Crumbles, Fresh Strawberries, House Made Balsamic Dressing

name: Rib Tips
description: One pound of our pork rib tips rubbed with our Smokeheads Sweet and Tangy Dry Rub and slow smoked over a blend of hickory and apple woods. Finished on the grill and served with your choice of our signature BBQ sauce and a side of cornbread.

name: Smoked Chopped Brisket
description: Our approach to smoked brisket is simple, but serious. Each brisket consists of just four ingredients and 18 hours of low heat and patience. The reward is a tender, smokey and juicy delicacy. Chopped and served by the pound and, as always, sauce on the side. Served with a side of our delicious Cornbread and topped with pickled onions. Can be Gluten-Free.

name: Whole BBQ Smoked Chicken
description: We start with an overnight brine, a dry rub and then slow smoke them with our signature wood blend until they are juicy, tender, smokey, but never dry. Served with Smokeheads House-Made Texas Mop BBQ Sauce. Served with a side of our delicious Cornbread. Can be Gluten-Free.

name: Half BBQ Smoked Chicken
description: We start with an overnight brine, a dry rub and then slow smoke them with our signature wood blend until they are juicy, tender, smokey but never dry. Served with Smokeheads House-Made Texas Mop BBQ Sauce. Served with a side of our delicious Cornbread. Can be Gluten-Free.

name: Smokeheads BBQ Platter
description: This meal is designed for those with large appetites or folks who just can’t make up their minds. Choose your proteins, a side and your favorite sauce. We’ll add in a wedge of our delicious cornbread. Order extra sauce if you’d like to really mix things up. Can be Gluten-Free.

name: Carolina Style Pulled Pork
description: Each bone-in pork shoulder is marinated in our Smokeheads Signature Dry Rub and smoked with a trio of hickory, apple and cherry woods until fork-tender and caked in a beautiful BBQ bark. Fork-pulled and served by the pound with your choice of sauce. Served with a side of our delicious Cornbread and topped with pickled onions. Can be Gluten-Free.

name: Texas Style Chopped Beef Brisket Sandwich
description: Each brioche bun sandwich is stacked with a heaping pile of tender, chopped brisket, pickled onions and your choice of sauce. Add a side of Smokeheads Slaw or Hand Cut Fries and you’re good to go.

name: Carolina Style Pulled Pork Sandwich
description: Beeler’s bone-in pork shoulder is marinated in our Smokeheads Signature Dry Rub and steadily smoked until beautifully caramelized, smoky and fork tender. We build each sandwich in true Carolina-style by loading a potato bun high with fork-pulled pork and topping it with sliced pickles, fresh coleslaw and pickled red onions. This sandwich goes perfect with our Smokeheads Mac & Cheese.

name: Mac & Cheese
description: Classic béchamel sauce, cheddar, provolone, and mozzarella cheeses topped with an herbed-panko crust. A quick finish under the broiler creates a delicious golden-brown crust. Vegetarian.

name: Seasoned Fries
description: Sprinkled with Sea Salt, Vegetarian and Gluten-Free.

name: Smokeheads Memphis-Style Coleslaw
description: Made in the traditional Southern style with freshly shredded green and red cabbage, carrots and red onion and tossed in a balanced dressing of mayo, vinegar, whole grain mustard and sugar. We love to eat our slaw with a fork full of smoked pork or chicken.

name: Homestyle Cornbread
description: Our cornbread is heavy on flavor and never disappoints.

name: Brisket Baked Beans
description: Our Brisket Baked Beans include plenty of burnt ends, thick cut bacon, pinto beans, a lil’ brown sugar and a shot of Bourbon. Sweet, salty and, above all, meaty. Just like our BBQ, these beans are slow cooked until the sweet and zesty flavors become one.

Always read the instructions fully and carefully before use to ensure that you're receiving the most accurate readings possible.
